projects.name: Domain: Finance
details: Domain: Finance
Environment:  MS Fabric, SSMS, Power BI, Azure Devops Dashboard

Description: The project involves migrating Equiom’s existing reporting ecosystem to Microsoft Fabric to improve performance, scalability, and usability. It includes modernizing SSRS and Power BI reports, integrating data from Salesforce, Business Central, and on-premises systems, and establishing secure, efficient data pipelines. This upgrade will streamline reporting, reduce costs, and enhance data-driven decision-making across the business.

projects.name: Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.
details: Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.
Performed data validation checks—including record counts, null checks, and duplicates—to confirm correct data movement into Microsoft Fabric.
Participated in SIT and UAT cycles, providing regular updates on testing progress and reporting issues for timely resolution.
Collaborated closely with business users, analysts, and developers to understand reporting requirements and ensure successful migration outcomes.
Joined daily and weekly project status discussions to communicate test results, risks, and dependencies across teams.
Logged, tracked, and reported defects throughout the migration lifecycle, ensuring issues were addressed before production deployment.

projects.name: Domain: Finance
details: Domain: Finance
Environment:  MS Fabric, SSMS, Power BI, Azure Devops Dashboard

Description: The project involves migrating Equiom’s existing reporting ecosystem to Microsoft Fabric to improve performance, scalability, and usability. It includes modernizing SSRS and Power BI reports, integrating data from Salesforce, Business Central, and on-premises systems, and establishing secure, efficient data pipelines. This upgrade will streamline reporting, reduce costs, and enhance data-driven decision-making across the business.

projects.name: Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.
details: Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.
Performed data validation checks—including record counts, null checks, and duplicates—to confirm correct data movement into Microsoft Fabric.
Participated in SIT and UAT cycles, providing regular updates on testing progress and reporting issues for timely resolution.
Collaborated closely with business users, analysts, and developers to understand reporting requirements and ensure successful migration outcomes.
Joined daily and weekly project status discussions to communicate test results, risks, and dependencies across teams.
Logged, tracked, and reported defects throughout the migration lifecycle, ensuring issues were addressed before production deployment.

periods.label: Equiom – MS Fabric Migration

entry.text: Project Name:  Equiom – MS Fabric Migration
Client:  Equiom
Role:  Test Engineer

periods.label: Domain: Finance

entry.text: Domain: Finance
Environment:  MS Fabric, SSMS, Power BI, Azure Devops Dashboard

Description: The project involves migrating Equiom’s existing reporting ecosystem to Microsoft Fabric to improve performance, scalability, and usability. It includes modernizing SSRS and Power BI reports, integrating data from Salesforce, Business Central, and on-premises systems, and establishing secure, efficient data pipelines. This upgrade will streamline reporting, reduce costs, and enhance data-driven decision-making across the business.

periods.label: Roles and Responsibilities:

entry.text: Roles and Responsibilities:
Prepared and executed comprehensive test cases to validate migrated SSRS and Power BI reports within Microsoft Fabric, ensuring accuracy and expected functionality.
Verified data in source (on-prem SQL Server, Salesforce) and target Fabric tables/dataflows to ensure complete and accurate migration.

periods.label: Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.

entry.text: Identified and resolved duplicate or inconsistent records in target datasets to maintain high data quality.
Performed data validation checks—including record counts, null checks, and duplicates—to confirm correct data movement into Microsoft Fabric.
Participated in SIT and UAT cycles, providing regular updates on testing progress and reporting issues for timely resolution.
Collaborated closely with business users, analysts, and developers to understand reporting requirements and ensure successful migration outcomes.
Joined daily and weekly project status discussions to communicate test results, risks, and dependencies across teams.
Logged, tracked, and reported defects throughout the migration lifecycle, ensuring issues were addressed before production deployment.
